name: Whispering Forest
summary: Behind Deathknell, the Whispering Forest lies quiet beneath western Tirisfal’s cliffs. Its lake, giant mushroom ring, and uncanny wildlife break the stillness, while corruption stirs beneath the soil.

sections.title: The Hidden Glen
sections.body: Beyond Northface Rock and Bandarion Keep, the Whispering Forest feels far removed from plague-touched Tirisfal. Afflicted deer and roaming predators share its woods with a tranquil lake. Nearby, giant mushrooms form a ring beneath a hovering cloud of mist, glowing with uncanny energy. The ghostly Knight of Mourning wanders among them, bound by oath. Natural magic lingers here in a land scarred by the Scourge.

sections.title: The Shadow Beneath the Woods
sections.body: An ancient dread stains the woods beneath their wonder. Centuries ago, high elves tried to settle Tirisfal Glades, but many began to go mad. Some believed an evil slept beneath the land, though no one proved the rumors. Vile Fin murlocs and the undead threshadon Blightsculler prowl the lake, and necromantic remnants blight the ruined settlement of Shadowvale. Across Lordaeron, mad wanderers still mutter fearful warnings of a consuming darkness beneath Tirisfal’s roots.

faq.q: Where is the Whispering Forest located?
aliases: how to get to whispering forest
faq.answer: The Whispering Forest lies in the mountains of western Tirisfal Glades, just west of Deathknell and south of Tyr's Fall. Northface Rock, a steep ridge with Bandarion Keep atop it, walls off the forest.

faq.q: What happens at the giant mushroom circle?
faq.answer: Giant mushrooms form a ring beneath a hovering cloud of mist, glowing with strange energy. The ghostly Knight of Mourning wanders there, bound by oath, while the ring’s magic remains unknown.
Tyr's Watch, an order of Forsaken paladins, holds the heights of Bandarion Keep. Near the fairy circle, the spectral Knight of Mourning wanders the woods, bound by oath.

faq.q: Why did the high elves abandon this region long ago?
faq.answer: After the high elves first reached Lordaeron’s shores, they tried to build a settlement in Tirisfal. Within a few years, many began to go mad. Some suspected an evil slept beneath the land, but the rumors were never proven. The elves abandoned the glades and traveled north.

Shadowvale is a ruined village southwest of the forest’s lake. The Tarnished dwell there alongside mindless undead afflicted by a necromantic crystal fragment dating back to clashes involving the Undercity.

angles.text: As a druid, you can feel the glowing faerie ring’s natural magic, one of the few such pulses left in blighted Lordaeron.
As an undead, you find this secluded woodland just beyond Deathknell, under Tyr's Watch at Bandarion Keep. Forgotten dangers lie close to the Undercity.
